definition: A component controlled to deliver or support a service, with recorded attributes and relationships.
rationale: Use this phrase for a managed component whose identity, attributes, and relationships are maintained for service information and controlled changes. A configuration item can also be an IT asset, but this phrase is not defined by ownership, purchase, financial value, or disposal. Do not use it for the configuration record or tool, or for an arbitrary component that is not controlled as a configuration item.

allowed.text: The configuration item records the database version and its relationship to the payment service.
allowed.rationale: Names a controlled component, a recorded attribute, and a service relationship.

not_allowed.text: The configuration item approved the purchase of the replacement server.
not_allowed.rationale: Conflates the managed component with an authority that approves an asset purchase.
